mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' THEN 1 END) AS reconciliationRequired, COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','IN_FLIGHT','RETRY') THEN 1 END) AS pending, COALESCE(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','IN_FLIGHT','RETRY') THEN created_at END), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) AS oldestSeconds FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','IN_FLIGHT','RETRY','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED')
SELECT command_id FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY created_at,command_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_command_delivery_outbox SET status='IN_FLIGHT',attempts=attempts+1,result_deadline_at=#{resultDeadlineAt}, last_error=NULL WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')

UPDATE inventory_command_delivery_outbox SET status='ACKNOWLEDGED',acknowledged_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), result_deadline_at=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status IN ('NEW','IN_FLIGHT','RETRY')

UPDATE inventory_command_delivery_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN attempts>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' ELSE 'RETRY' END, next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},result_deadline_at=NULL, last_error='Inventory command result deadline expired' WHERE status='IN_FLIGHT' AND result_deadline_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,command_type,order_id,status,attempts,last_error,recovered_by, recovery_reason,recovered_at,created_at FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE status='IN_FLIGHT' AND result_deadline_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND attempts>=#{maxAttempts} ORDER BY created_at,command_id

SELECT command_id,command_type,order_id,status,attempts,last_error,recovered_by, recovery_reason,recovered_at,created_at FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' ORDER BY created_at,command_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT command_id,command_type,order_id,status,attempts,last_error,recovered_by, recovery_reason,recovered_at,created_at FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE command_id=#{commandId}

SELECT command_id,command_type,order_id,status,attempts,last_error,recovered_by, recovery_reason,recovered_at,created_at FROM inventory_command_delivery_outbox WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_command_delivery_outbox SET status='CLOSED',recovered_by=#{recoveredBy},recovery_reason=#{recoveryReason}, recovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND command_type='RESERVE' AND status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'

UPDATE inventory_command_delivery_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),result_deadline_at=NULL,last_error=NULL, recovered_by=#{recoveredBy},recovery_reason=#{recoveryReason},recovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
